Major cell-type annotations

Source: R/majorCellTypes.R
majorCellTypes.Rd

A factor (or character) vector annotating samples by major cell type.

Usage

data(majorCellTypes)

Format

A vector of length N with levels for major cell types.

Examples

data(majorCellTypes)
table(majorCellTypes)
